resources.string: Audio workspace
Create audio
Audio gathers local speech, music, sound effects, and voices in one workspace. Choose the kind of audio you want to make.
Write your prompt or text, run it, and play the result in the workspace. Finished clips are saved to the audio gallery.
If nothing runs, open Audio models from this screen and install the model the task needs.
Queue longer audio jobs
Long audio generations can be added to the generation queue so you can keep using the app.
Open the generation queue to follow progress. A finished job keeps its audio file and history entry.
If a job fails, read the error in the queue, fix the model or settings, and add it again.
Audio models
Install speech models
Audio models lists curated speech model bundles and lets you add a custom one. Pick the bundle for the voice or recognition task you need.
Start the download and wait for the bundle to show as installed. It then appears in the matching Audio tool.
If a download fails, check storage and connection, retry, or use a custom bundle with a valid prefix.
Generation queue
Follow queued generations
The generation queue lists image, video, and audio jobs waiting to run or already running, one at a time.
Each row shows its state and progress. Finished jobs move to the history, where you can open the result.
Cancel a stuck job from its row, or open the history to see why a failed job stopped before re-adding it.
DeepSeek task viewer
Watch a DeepSeek task
This viewer shows a project the main model handed to the DeepSeek subagent: its state, current phase, and elapsed time.
Scroll the subagent conversation and Harness activity. Context usage and disk cache size show how much the subagent has used.
If it shows Needs direction or Failed, read the model error, copy the diagnostics, and reply in the main chat to continue.
Server editor
Edit a local model server
The server editor sets how a local llama.cpp server launches the chosen model, including context size and every launch option.
Save to keep the profile. You return to Chats, where the server is ready to start and chat with.
If the server crashes or runs out of memory, reopen the editor, lower the context or offload, and save again.
Servers
Manage servers and sharing
Servers collects model servers, sharing, distributed inference, Ollama, and Termux in one place. Each card has an Open or Manage button.
Cards show live status such as saved servers or the Termux connection, so you can see what is running before opening it.
If a card shows disconnected or nothing saved, open it and finish its setup, then come back to check the status.
Search
Search the whole app
Global search looks across tools, chats, Agent projects, installed models, and notes. Type in the search box.
Results are grouped by kind. Use Show all to expand a group, then tap a result to open it. Recent searches are kept for quick reuse.
If nothing is found, try another word; English and Spanish names both work. Clear recent searches to start fresh.
Open the File Station web page

While File Station is running, the Status card shows its address. Show sharing codes reveals the QR codes, Copy address copies the link and Open in browser opens the page here. Scan a QR from another device on the same network and sign in if a password is set.

The web page lists your folders with upload, rename, move, copy, trash and archive actions; read-only folders hide the write actions. Open a text or Markdown file to use the editor, and open Tools in the sidebar for image, PDF, document and media conversions, hashes and the duplicate finder. Media conversion needs FFmpeg (see Media conversion (FFmpeg)).

If the page does not load, check that both devices share the network and Visible on the network is on, then restart File Station after changing the port. A wrong password returns to the sign-in; Sign out everyone resets all sessions.
Hand a task to DeepSeek

Open the chat settings and turn on Allow DeepSeek delegation in the DeepSeek runtime section, then pick a runtime that shows Ready. The Delegation setting decides when the chat hands work over: Auto, Prefer DeepSeek or Only when I ask. Then ask the chat for a coding or file task.
While the task runs, a DeepSeek task running bar appears in the chat, and the robot icon in the top bar opens the DeepSeek task viewer. Tap either to follow the state, current phase and elapsed time.

If nothing is delegated, check that the runtime is Ready and the subagent server is a running llama-server. If a task stops, open the viewer and tap Continue, or Cancel task; files already written in the project stay.
Send a correction to the same task

To change or fix DeepSeek\'s work, use the Message the subagent box on the Conversation tab, or simply tell the main chat. Corrections go to the same task, project and thread; they do not start a new project.

After you send, the message appears in the conversation and a finished task reopens with your message. The Subagent tab shows its loop and the Harness tab lists the threads, changed files and the last model error.
If the message cannot be sent, wait until the task state is no longer Starting runtime, or tap Continue first. Cancel task stops the subagent without deleting project files.
Read the project files
The main chat can list, read, search and attach files from a DeepSeek project, but it does not review or test the work itself. Ask it, for example, to show what changed or attach the result.
Result files appear on the Conversation tab, and Open project files opens the project in the workspace file browser. The Harness tab lists changed files and deliverables.
If the files cannot be opened, check that the task\'s project still exists and the runtime is ready, then try Open project files again. Reading is read-only: ask for changes through a correction.
Servers, caches and helpers

Each chat runs on its own server, so you can keep several models ready at once. Prepare caches builds a base cache of the tool prompt so new chats start right away, and Keep KV cache on disk for this chat (chat settings, Memory) saves a long chat so returning to it skips reprocessing.

Disk caches only work with local llama.cpp servers started by this app, not remote servers, Ollama, llama-swap or LiteRT. Cache size is shown next to Clear cache, and the chat servers can restart once to enable it. Models with large contexts can take hundreds of MB per chat.

In the Chats menu, Helper models… sets a title model and the vision helper that describes images for text-only models; both start a temporary server only when enough RAM is free. Clear a cache if disk space runs low; it is rebuilt on the next reply.
